title: Prospective cohort study of corneal endothelial cell loss after Baerveldt glaucoma implantation
indication: Refractory glaucoma (secondary, neovascular, or wide conjunctival scarring after failed filtration or retinal surgery); Table 1: acBGI POAG 15, exfoliation 15, neovascular 3, other secondary 12 of 45 eyes; ppBGI neovascular 12, exfoliation 1, other secondary 1 of 14 eyes; mostly pseudophakic

groups.description: Baerveldt BG101-350 (350 mm2 endplate) with the tube inserted into the anterior chamber through a 23-gauge scleral tunnel; single surgeon, Fukui 2012-2015; prospective cohort (UMIN000007812)
Baerveldt BG102-350 with Hoffmann elbow, tube inserted into the vitreous cavity through the pars plana in previously vitrectomized eyes; same surgeon

exclusions.what: Tables 3 and 4 'Tube insertion' and 'Contralateral' quadrant columns
exclusions.reason: Peripheral measurement locations (each the mean of two peripheral points) in the same eyes as the central series; the central location is extracted so that each group has one series and stays comparable with central ECD elsewhere

exclusions.what: Table 2 (all 41 eyes, both arms pooled), including its 'Average' five-point column
exclusions.reason: Union of the two arms whose central series are extracted from Tables 3 and 4

exclusions.what: P-value rows of Tables 2-4; Table 5 correlations; Table 7 logistic model for more than 30% loss
exclusions.reason: p-values and model estimates are not admissible; Table 7 is defined by a postoperative outcome

notes: Role: anterior chamber and pars plana tube insertion are two standard techniques with the same device class and no investigational agent; both control-role, separate groups.

Of 59 enrolled eyes, 41 completed ECD measurement at all follow-up visits (18 with low photo quality); the arm series use these eyes (column n of Tables 3 and 4). Two acBGI implants were removed for plate escape and three eyes were lost to follow-up.

series.baseline_label: Preoperative (Table 3 row label) = preoperative central ECD of the operated eye
series.notes: Table 3 column 'Center (n = 32)', rows Preoperative, 3, 6 and 12 months; data shown as mean ± SD; Konan XI FA-3709P non-contact specular microscope, manual centre-dot method; column n applies to every visit (eyes with complete ECD at all visits).

series.baseline_label: Preoperative (Table 4 row label) = preoperative central ECD of the operated eye
series.notes: Table 4 column 'Center (n = 9)', rows Preoperative, 3, 6 and 12 months; data shown as mean ± SD; column n applies to every visit (eyes with complete ECD at all visits).
